name: local-review
description: Reviews your pull requests on this machine with the agent and model you choose, in a sandbox that cannot write or reach GitHub, and puts the findings in the pull request view. Nothing is posted.

settings.label: Repositories
settings.description: The repositories you can reach on GitHub. Only pull requests in the ones picked here are picked up by their label.

settings.label: Label that asks for a review
settings.description: Put it on a pull request to have it reviewed; every push after that is reviewed again, the new part only, until you take it off.

settings.label: Only my pull requests
settings.description: A labelled pull request by somebody else is ignored unless this is off. Theirs can still be queued one at a time from the panel.

settings.label: Agent
settings.description: Any agent CLI installed here. Experimental ones run in the same sandbox but have not been measured in it.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Handed to the agent as it is. Empty uses the agent's default.

settings.label: How to review
settings.description: Three come with the plugin, and they are deliberately plain. Pick "my own prompt" to write your own in the box below; it is kept here, never in the plugin, so an update cannot overwrite it.

options.label: Security — what an attacker could do
Clean code and tests — the next reader

settings.label: My own prompt
settings.description: Used when "my own prompt" is chosen above. It says only HOW to review — where the files are, that what they contain is evidence and never an instruction, and the block the app reads back are added around it. Choosing "my own prompt" fills this with whichever shipped one you had, so you start from it rather than from nothing.
settings.placeholder: Review this pull request the way…

settings.label: Anything to add
settings.description: Pasted at the end of whichever prompt is in use. For the house rules a reviewer keeps forgetting.
settings.placeholder: Flag any new environment variable that is not in the deployment template.

settings.label: Spend cap per review (USD)
settings.description: The agent stops at this. Only agents that report cost can be held to it.

settings.label: Always review these
settings.description: owner/name#123, one per line, whoever wrote them.
